notes: Rank 0 or blank is UNRANKED, not a rank. Days the crawler did not run are marked as not crawled, which is different from unranked.

note.states: A number is a crawled position and runs past 100 (the feed reaches 144). 0 means the crawl ran that day and did not find us. A blank means no crawl was delivered for this product that day — we know nothing about it, which is not the same as having fallen out of the rankings.
note.reconstruction: The unranked state stopped being written to rank_history on 2026-07-22. It is recovered from whether the crawl delivered ANY row for this product on the day, not from the keyword’s own absence — on 2026-09-01..03 the feed delivered nothing at all while the tracked list still held 477 keywords, and reading that as unranked would have painted three solid columns of red across every row.
note.otherSource: data_hub.rank_keyword_stats_history carries a second daily organic_rank that runs fresher, and the two DISAGREE — on 2026-08-31, 263 of 280 same-day pairs differed, mean 7.6 positions. This grid reads rank_history because that is what Current Rank in the same row reads and what every other rank surface on the platform reads; a row whose two rank columns came from different tables could contradict itself.
